title: VMX music player integration - requires VMX by Dark Nebula
Enable VMX integration
desc: If ON will use VMX to play music when events are triggered in game. Will display VMX information in the Music Display panel (old UI only at present - on list to finish in new UI)

title: VMX Stream Data folder location
desc: Set this to the folder containing the VMX StreamData files, usually c:/users/(user)/AppData/Roaming/VMX_StreamData
